6/G.goal: Describe the historical evolution of virtual reality from early stereoscopic devices through the growth phase of commercial headsets and the metaverse using a four-phase framework.
6/G.achieves: It supports the course aim of building foundational XR knowledge by helping the learner understand how key immersive technologies and terminology developed before studying current system development and optimization.

6/O1.goal: Describe the historical evolution of virtual reality by organizing its major developments into four phases with approximate time spans.
6/O1.achieves: It gives the learner a chronological foundation for interpreting later course topics on XR hardware, software, and immersive user experience.
